name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Denominator Datasets
description: Medicaid MAX-TAF denominator datasets contain harmonized Medicaid Analytic eXtract (MAX) and T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) enrollment products, including a beneficiary-year denominator and county/ZCTA aggregate products.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Denominator V1 Datasets
description: Harmonized Medicaid MAX-TAF beneficiary-year denominator covering all states from 2000-2018, with cohort indicator flags (fee-for-service, dual-eligible, disabled, full-benefit) and county/ZCTA yearly and daily aggregate counts and denominator covariates (stratified counts). State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Denominator File
description: Beneficiary-year file including every individual enrolled in Medicaid in any month of the year. Includes demographics, a harmonized race variable, the number of months enrolled, and cohort indicator flags (ffs_ind, dual_ind, disabled_ind, full_benefit_ind), where each flag requires the status to hold all year.

name: Daily County-Level Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid beneficiary counts by cohort (n_bene__<cohort>) and enrolled months (n_months_enrolled__<cohort>). Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.

name: Daily County-Level Denominator Covariates
description: Daily County-level Medicaid beneficiary counts by cohort, stratified by age group, sex, race, dual status, managed care, and eligibility group. These strata serve as the area-level covariates: population composition (e.g., percent female or percent dual-eligible) can be derived by summing over the other strata. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.

name: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF Admissions Datasets
description: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF admissions datasets contain outcome-specific Medicaid inpatient admission products derived from harmonized MAX and TAF inpatient claims using configured diagnosis-code, diagnosis-position, and admission-selection rules.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF Admissions V1 Datasets
description: Outcome-specific Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admission products covering all states from 2000-2018. Each outcome has its own folder (e.g., mental_health/) containing qualifying admission files and county/ZCTA yearly and daily admission counts, with the outcome definition encoded in the file name as icdset<N>_dx<positions>_<selection> (e.g., admissions_icdset1_dxall_all_yyyy.parquet). State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Mental Health Admissions
description: Mental health Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admission outcomes. Admission files are named by outcome definition as admissions_icdset<N>_dx<positions>_<selection>_yyyy.parquet; aggregate counts are in <geography>/counts_yyyy.parquet. Current definition: icdset1_dxall_all, where a qualifying admission has a mental health diagnosis code from ICD code set 1 in any diagnosis position (dxall), including all qualifying admissions without readmission exclusions (all). Placeholder definition; code set details to be added.
